cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort

decision_rule: This is a development probe. Continue to a full consumed-development run only if strict parsing succeeds for all 120 rows, exact post-type sets reach at least 0.70, and product-label exact sets do not fall below the 0.90 same-row baseline. A selected production candidate must subsequently pass a fresh unseen final cohort under the unchanged preregistered floors.
global_stop: The transport refuses request seven and reserves worst-case bytes and output tokens before every call. There are no retries or fallback calls, and capacity cannot transfer to another lane, prompt, cohort, or provider.

prior_probe_results.high_effort_thinking: stopped after one batch exhausted 16384 output tokens and truncated JSON
prior_probe_results.low_effort_thinking: stopped after one valid batch reduced post-type exact sets from 10/20 to 7/20 and product-label exact sets from 18/20 to 14/20

prompt.post_type_wire_shape: thirteen required booleans; strict application derivation of the exact true-key array

reason: The unseen gate and consumed-development results show omitted secondary post types under the array-only wire shape. Thinking mode was slower, costlier, and worse or invalid. This probe makes the already-required independent thirteen-type pass observable in one non-thinking call, without changing taxonomy meanings or adding a second provider request.
